mapper.select: SELECT c.customer_name AS depositorName, '우리은행' AS depositBankName, a.account_no_enc AS depositAccountNo, a.status AS accountStatus FROM account a JOIN customer c ON a.customer_id = c.id WHERE a.account_no_hash = #{accountNoHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET balance = #{balance}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
